_readme: AI text prompts (sent to Perchance's ai-text-plugin). The game fills in the {placeholders} and sends the result as the instruction.

Placeholders: {name} {title} {fullname} {race} {age} {appearance} {clothing} {outfit} {personality} {traits} {trust} {lewd} {mood} {service} {stance} {client} (always empty now: clients are not described) {setting} {house} {relationship} {guidance} {hook} {backstory} {date} {situation} {lust} {other} {otherDesc} {dynamic} {outcome} (how it ends: did she finish, was she satisfied, demon feeding/drain; worded by "outcomes" below; if a custom template lacks {outcome}, it is added to {guidance}).
{other} / {otherDesc}: the second lady in scenes with two of them. {dynamic}: how the scene plays out given their bond (from bonds.json dynamics). guidance is inserted wherever {guidance} appears.

Which prompt is used where: scene (client highlights), private (private time), train, proposition (date invitations), encounter (visits, lovers waiting), reckless, breakup, backstory, and one per shared scene type in bonds.json (shared, shared_rivals, shared_friend, shared_lesson, shared_bath). Add a shared scene with its own 'ai' key and add a matching prompt here.
{name} is her name only; {title} is her title if she has one (Lady, Captain, Professor...); {fullname} is the title + name, used where a template first introduces her.
guidance: Use vivid, grounded physical detail and natural spoken dialogue that fits her personality. Avoid flowery purple prose, modern slang, or meta-commentary.

Edit freely; empty strings are skipped.
